content: Live-verified SDG API series codes: 8.1.1=NY_GDP_PCAP (Annual growth rate of real GDP per capita %), dimensions={Reporting Type}; 8.2.1=SL_EMP_PCAP (Annual growth rate of real GDP per employed person %), dimensions={Age, Reporting Type}; 2.3.1=PD_AGR_SSFP (Productivity of small-scale food producers, constant 2017 intl $), dimensions={Sex, Reporting Type}; 6.4.1=ER_H2O_WUEYST (Water Use Efficiency USD/m3), dimensions={Reporting Type, Activity}. Each indicator has a DIFFERENT dimension key set -- dimension filtering cannot be hardcoded to Activity:TOTAL alone.
